text: All Wi-Fi traffic is encrypted by default on all wireless routers.

room.label: U.S. adult internet users
room.questionWording: True / False / Not sure item in Pew's cybersecurity knowledge quiz (American Trends Panel).
room.note: 2016 survey; older data. Topline: 11% true, 45% false (correct), 44% not sure.

truthSource.label: Federal Trade Commission, Are Public Wi-Fi Networks Safe?
truthSource.oneLine: Whether a Wi-Fi network encrypts traffic depends on how it is set up; what protects you on public Wi-Fi today is mostly the websites' and apps' own encryption.
